stream.name: Respyra-Events
stream.lifecycle: Advertised at desktop Python startup and retained through final Close. The default name may change during setup before subscription. Start requires the bundled native recorder to subscribe to the selected breathing input and markers and receive raw samples before acceptance or display creation. The first recorded marker embeds pre-recording setup events with their original sequence and LSL times. Recording ends after study cleanup, before the final HTML Close.
stream.sample: One compact JSON object per LSL sample. The LSL sample timestamp equals payload.lsl_time. Record this stream together with the selected Vernier or Polar input outlet.

common_fields.event: Exact event name from the events table below.
common_fields.run_id: Random UUID shared by every marker from one Respyra run.
common_fields.seq: Strictly increasing marker sequence within the run; gaps reveal missing marker samples.
common_fields.lsl_time: Local LSL clock at publication, in seconds. The outlet uses the same value as the LSL sample timestamp.
common_fields.trial: One-based trial number, or null outside a trial.
common_fields.condition: Condition name, or null outside a trial.
common_fields.phase: Active phase name, or null between phases.
common_fields.screen: Active HTML startup form or blocking PsychoPy screen identity, otherwise null.

event_field_definitions.input_action: Windows keyboard or mouse event kind.
event_field_definitions.event_lsl_time: LSL clock at OS input callback; marker lsl_time is publication time.
event_field_definitions.scope: respyra_windows: only this experiment and desktop controller receive optional input markers.
event_field_definitions.excluded_uids: LSL outlet UIDs explicitly excluded from native recording at Start, after removing required outlets. This identifies outlet instances, not persistent source IDs.
event_field_definitions.uid: LSL outlet instance UID whose Record checkbox changed before Start.
event_field_definitions.center: Comparison input calibration center, in unit, calculated from that input's accepted range samples.
event_field_definitions.amplitude: Comparison input calibration half-range after range scaling, in unit; Vernier uses a minimum of 0.5 N.
event_field_definitions.unit: Comparison input's native unit: N for Vernier Force or g for a Polar waveform.
event_field_definitions.polarity: Comparison Polar waveform's signed multiplier (+1 by default); null for Vernier Force.
event_field_definitions.accepted: Boolean: whether this key was allowed in its current input context; false also covers keys discarded at a screen transition.
event_field_definitions.control: Typed experimenter prompt command: continue (Space) or retry (R).
event_field_definitions.prompt_id: Run UUID and visible-prompt shown sequence. Commands apply only to this exact prompt instance.
event_field_definitions.accuracy: Accepted 1â€“5 performance rating for this trial.
event_field_definitions.amplitude_n: Calculated breathing range half amplitude in Newtons; null for Polar input.
event_field_definitions.amplitude_value: Calculated breathing range half amplitude in signal_unit.
event_field_definitions.breathing_judgment: Accepted n/d/s response: normal, deeper, or shallower.
event_field_definitions.center_n: Calculated force center in Newtons; null for Polar input.
event_field_definitions.center_value: Calculated breathing signal center in signal_unit.
event_field_definitions.conditions: Condition names in the TrialHandler input list; each selected trial is marked separately.
event_field_definitions.confidence: Accepted 1â€“5 confidence rating for this trial.
event_field_definitions.compatible: Boolean: discovery metadata satisfies the raw Vernier Force (N) or an exact Polar signed-waveform contract; live samples are checked separately before acceptance.
event_field_definitions.dot_feedback_mode: Configured visual dot feedback color mode.
event_field_definitions.error_type: Python exception class that stopped the run.
event_field_definitions.escaped: Boolean: tracking stopped through Escape; null if tracking raised an exception.
event_field_definitions.feedback_enabled: Boolean: whether this condition displays error-dependent dot feedback.
event_field_definitions.feedback_gain: Gain applied to the selected breathing signal about the calibrated center for this condition.
event_field_definitions.field: Setup field: participant, session, marker_name, record_keyboard or record_mouse.
event_field_definitions.force_channel_index: Zero-based channel index selected in the raw Vernier outlet; null for Polar input.
event_field_definitions.input_contract: Selected input contract: vernier-force/1, respyra-polar-pca/1, or respyra-polar-phan-signed/1.
event_field_definitions.input_polarity: Signed multiplier applied to a Polar waveform after the experimenter chooses inhale direction (+1 or -1); null for Vernier Force.
event_field_definitions.key: PsychoPy key name returned/discarded during the experiment; KeyboardEvent.key for HTML participant fields.
event_field_definitions.mean_abs_compensated_error_n: Mean absolute target-minus-displayed-force error in Newtons; null for Polar input or missing samples.
event_field_definitions.mean_abs_compensated_error_value: Mean absolute tracking error in signal_unit; null if no tracking samples were read.
event_field_definitions.message: Diagnostic error text; not a stable machine-readable code.
event_field_definitions.method: PsychoPy TrialHandler order method, such as sequential or random.
event_field_definitions.number: Countdown numeral first visible on a display flip.
event_field_definitions.outcome: Calibration uses result/escaped/no_data_fallback/error; tracking uses completed/escaped/error; the wrapper result uses finished/error.
event_field_definitions.origin: Connection requested through selection, remembered identity (memory), or RESPYRA_LSL_SOURCE_ID (environment).
event_field_definitions.participant: Participant identifier submitted in the HTML form; treat as potentially identifying research data.
event_field_definitions.psychopy_time: PsychoPy key timestamp if supplied by the underlying input call, in that call's clock domain; otherwise null. Use the LSL sample timestamp for cross-stream alignment.
event_field_definitions.range_cal_s: Configured range calibration duration in seconds.
event_field_definitions.range_percentiles: Two-element lower/upper percentile pair used for range clipping.
event_field_definitions.range_scale: Scale applied to the half amplitude after percentile clipping.
event_field_definitions.reason: Stable code describing an aborted trial or run.
event_field_definitions.sample_count: Number of selected input samples contributing tracking errors; null if tracking raised before returning.
event_field_definitions.segments: Ordered target sine segments, each with freq_hz and n_cycles.
event_field_definitions.session: Session identifier submitted in the HTML form.
event_field_definitions.subject: Three-digit BIDS-style subject label for a numeric participant, otherwise null.
event_field_definitions.task: BIDS-style task label; respyra for this study.
event_field_definitions.variables: Original custom participant label/value pairs captured when XDF recording starts.
event_field_definitions.ui_seq: Optional, strictly increasing HTML action sequence captured before IPC; an action can cause multiple marker events.
event_field_definitions.ui_time_ms: Optional performance.now() milliseconds captured at the local or phone HTML event callback. Each browser has a separate clock, not an LSL timestamp; do not directly align it with breathing samples.
event_field_definitions.ui_origin: Optional local or remote experiment controller origin.
event_field_definitions.ui_client_seq: Optional sequence within the originating browser. ui_seq orders all accepted pipe commands across both controllers.
event_field_definitions.source: Experiment input API that observed or discarded the key: waitKeys, check_keys, clearEvents, local_control, or remote_control. Controller responses are semantic commands, not physical keyboard events.
event_field_definitions.source_id: Exact LSL source_id of the selected study input stream.
event_field_definitions.source_ids: Required selected input and marker source IDs subscribed by the native recorder.
event_field_definitions.policy: Native recording policy; visible_and_late_except_excluded records current and future streams except explicitly unchecked LSL UIDs.
event_field_definitions.clock_reference: Optional frozen respyra-clock-reference-v1 mapping between local LSL and UTC, with Europe/Berlin display zone, timeapi.io/system source, API status, measured RTT and transport uncertainty. Wall-clock accuracy and subsequent drift are not guaranteed. Importers must transform the LSL anchor by the marker clock correction when synchronizing XDF.
event_field_definitions.pre_recording_events: Ordered setup marker payloads emitted before native XDF recording began. They retain their original sequence and LSL times inside recording.started; they are not separate XDF samples.
event_field_definitions.stream_name: LSL name of the selected study input stream.
event_field_definitions.signal_unit: Native input unit: N for Vernier Force or g for Polar waveform.
event_field_definitions.streams: Discovery results: list of objects with source_id, stream_name, stream_type, compatible, and reason. Rejected streams are included; compatible requires unique source_id and one exact supported input contract.
event_field_definitions.target_amplitude_n: Global calibrated target sine amplitude in Newtons; null for Polar input.
event_field_definitions.target_center_n: Global calibrated target sine center in Newtons; null for Polar input.
event_field_definitions.target_amplitude_value: Global calibrated target sine amplitude in signal_unit.
event_field_definitions.target_center_value: Global calibrated target sine center in signal_unit.
event_field_definitions.total_trials: Total number of trials scheduled by TrialHandler.
event_field_definitions.trials_completed: Number of trials whose feedback screen was dismissed normally.
event_field_definitions.value: Accepted answer key for this assessment event.
event_field_definitions.y_max_n: Upper visual trace force limit in Newtons; null for Polar input.
event_field_definitions.y_min_n: Lower visual trace force limit in Newtons; null for Polar input.
event_field_definitions.y_max_value: Upper visual trace limit in signal_unit.
event_field_definitions.y_min_value: Lower visual trace limit in signal_unit.

timing_contract: Experiment screen *.shown and phase *.started markers run on the first PsychoPy display flip, directly in Python without desktop IPC. A *.dismissed marker follows the accepted key; a *.ended marker follows the phase function return. Experiment key markers are published when PsychoPy reports the key. HTML setup actions capture ui_seq/ui_time_ms before IPC and are published serially when Python consumes the action; their LSL timestamp describes backend receipt, not an exact browser paint or click timestamp. Setup shown/hidden describe form readiness and the backend accept/reject transition. Worker completion markers describe Python observing the result. No marker is emitted for every animation frame or breathing sample; record the selected raw outlet for the continuous signal. Native wrapper closure is observed at the next control/input checkpoint; forced process termination cannot finalize markers.

input.mouse_event.when: Optional mouse events during XDF recording, within Respyra windows.

input.keyboard_event.when: Optional keyboard events during XDF recording, within Respyra windows.

recording.started.when: The native recorder has subscribed to the selected input, markers and the derived breathing stream and received samples from each, before setup acceptance and PsychoPy display creation. pre_recording_events preserves earlier setup marker payloads; subject, session, task, and variables identify this XDF run.

recording.finalizing.when: Study cleanup has finished; the recorder will drain pending samples, close and verify the XDF. This event is inside the recording; the final HTML result/Close markers are outside it.

recording.option.changed.when: Python observes a recording-option checkbox change.

source.polarity.set.when: The experimenter confirms whether inhale lowers the selected Polar waveform before Start.

recording.stream.changed.when: Python observes a stream Record checkbox change before Start.

run.recorder_connected.when: Legacy event from the former setup subscriber gate; no longer emitted. Use recording.started for the native recorder gate.

run.configured.when: Study timing, input contract and feedback settings are fixed before the first screen.

run.started.when: Instructions are accepted and the experiment begins.

run.completed.when: The final screen is dismissed after all trials.

run.aborted.when: The operator or participant exits early, including dialog cancellation or Escape.

ui.wrapper.closed.when: Python observes native wrapper shutdown after recorder subscription: at the next experiment input checkpoint or after the final HTML screen. reason identifies close_button, window_closed, protocol_failure, or engine_failed; forced termination cannot publish this event.

ui.wrapper.close_button.clicked.when: Python observes the final HTML Close button's native shutdown request. Recorder subscription is still required.

ui.experiment.stop.requested.when: Python observes an experimenter Stop command at a cancellation checkpoint. Cleanup follows; the control window and marker outlet remain open.

ui.prompt_control.when: Python consumes Continue or Retry for one visible prompt, after its dismissal marker and any calibration retry/accept marker, before acknowledging applied. Rejected admitted commands also emit this event with accepted=false and reason stale_prompt, unavailable_control, prompt_busy, or prompt_interrupted. ui_origin/ui_client_seq identify the controller; ui_time_ms is its own clock. Authentication/schema/revision denials before the Python pipe do not emit study markers.

ui.wrapper.result.requested.when: After cleanup, Python requests the final HTML result screen from the native shell. This timestamps the request, not browser paint. Not emitted when the desktop is already closing.

source.connected.when: The selected Vernier Force or Polar waveform inlet validates metadata and live samples.

source.lost.when: Selected input samples stop or the inlet raises during a phase.

source.comparison.skipped.when: A compatible comparison source cannot be opened or lacks a valid calibration range; its raw LSL outlet remains eligible for native recording.

source.comparison.lost.when: A comparison inlet stops supplying valid samples; selected feedback continues.

source.comparison.calibrated.when: An alternative breathing input receives its own percentile range calibration after the accepted range attempt.

source.disconnected.when: Respyra closes its inlet during cleanup.

source.ui.add.clicked.when: The Add LSL Stream button is activated, before discovery starts.

source.ui.selection.changed.when: The operator selects a discovery result; this does not yet change the accepted input.

source.ui.use.clicked.when: Use Selected Stream is activated for a compatible result.

source.scan.started.when: An asynchronous LSL scan is requested from the setup dialog.

source.scan.completed.when: The UI receives and displays discovery results and compatibility reasons.

source.scan.failed.when: Discovery fails; the operator can retry without starting the experiment.

source.scan.cancelled.when: Setup closes with discovery pending; any result is discarded after worker cleanup.

source.connection.started.when: The UI requests metadata and live-sample validation for a selected or remembered source.

source.connection.failed.when: The UI observes a failed connection or memory write; no new source is accepted.

source.connection.cancelled.when: A pending connection result is discarded after worker cleanup because setup closed; its inlet is closed and its identity is not saved. Use participant.dialog.hidden for the UI close time.

source.connection.accepted.when: The UI accepts the validated live input and enables Start Experiment when participant fields are valid.

source.memory.loaded.when: The saved source identity is loaded; it still requires a fresh connection and validation.

source.memory.saved.when: An explicitly chosen, validated source identity is saved atomically for later launches.

source.memory.invalid.when: Saved settings are unreadable or incompatible; selection remains available.

source.setup.failed.when: An unexpected setup control or protocol error rejects the HTML form and fails the run.

participant.dialog.shown.when: The HTML participant/session form becomes enabled after recorder subscription; Python consumes its readiness action.

participant.field.key.when: An HTML keydown reaches either participant text field, including cursor and deletion keys; key uses KeyboardEvent.key.

participant.field.edited.when: An HTML input event changes a participant, session or custom-variable field; value is the full text after that edit, including pasted text. Custom variables are encoded as a bounded JSON array.

participant.button.ok.clicked.when: Start Experiment is activated by mouse, keyboard, or HTML form submission; retains the original marker name.

participant.button.cancel.clicked.when: Cancel is activated by mouse, keyboard, or Escape in the setup form.

participant.dialog.accepted.when: Python accepts Start Experiment after checking participant/session values, live selected input and native recorder readiness with raw samples.

participant.dialog.rejected.when: Python rejects setup after Cancel, Escape, native window close, or a setup error.

participant.dialog.hidden.when: The backend transitions out of the enabled HTML setup form after acceptance or rejection; not a display-flip timestamp.

participant.dialog.submitted.when: The dialog returns accepted participant and session values.

display.opened.when: The PsychoPy window and stimuli have been created.

display.closed.when: The PsychoPy window is closed during cleanup.

input.key.when: A key is returned by an experiment input poll or wait, or discarded while clearing the key buffer.
input.key.note: HTML participant field keys use participant.field.key and are observed through the desktop control pipe.

input.escape.when: Escape is observed in an experiment input poll or wait.

calibration.attempt.started.when: The first displayed frame of each range-calibration attempt.

calibration.attempt.ended.when: A range-calibration attempt stops, including result, Escape, no-data fallback, or error paths.

calibration.saturation.when: The calibration result reports sensor saturation.

calibration.retry.when: R is pressed on the calibration result screen.

calibration.accepted.when: Space is pressed on the calibration result screen.

calibration.completed.when: Range calibration returns successfully with measured samples; a no-data fallback fails the run.

trial.condition.selected.when: A trial becomes current, before its ready screen.

trial.started.when: The trial-ready screen is accepted, before baseline.

trial.aborted.when: Escape ends a trial before normal feedback dismissal.

baseline.calculated.when: Per-trial diagnostic baseline center/amplitude are calculated.

countdown.tick.when: A new countdown numeral is first displayed.

tracking.started.when: First displayed tracking frame; target parameters describe the entire sine trajectory.

tracking.ended.when: Tracking phase returns or raises; sample_count and escaped are null on an error.

assessment.completed.when: All three self-assessment responses have been accepted.

ui.instructions.dismissed.when: The instructions screen returns a key.

ui.calibration_ready.dismissed.when: The calibration-ready screen returns a key.

ui.calibration_result.shown.when: The calibration result screen flip occurs.

ui.calibration_result.dismissed.when: The calibration result screen returns a key.

ui.trial_ready.dismissed.when: The trial-ready screen returns a key.

ui.accuracy.dismissed.when: The performance-rating question returns a key.

ui.breathing_judgment.dismissed.when: The breathing-judgment question returns a key.

ui.confidence.dismissed.when: The confidence question returns a key.

ui.trial_feedback.shown.when: The post-trial feedback screen flip occurs.

ui.trial_feedback.dismissed.when: The post-trial feedback screen returns a key.

ui.end.dismissed.when: The experiment-complete screen returns a key.
